<b>Mask Shards</b> are [[Items (Silksong)|Items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that are used to increase [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Hornet (Silksong)#Health|Health]].

== Use ==
4 Mask Shards are needed to form an Ancient Mask, which increases Hornet's [[Hornet_(Silksong)#Health_and_Silk|maximum health]] by 1.

With a total of 20 Mask Shards in the game, Hornet's health can be increased by 5, for a maximum of <b>10</b> permanent Masks.

Completing a Mask will also fully restore Hornet's health.

== How to Acquire ==
A total of six Mask Shards are accessible in [[Act 1]], allowing for Hornet to have one additional Mask by the Act's completion.

Ten more Mask Shards are accessible in [[Act 2]], allowing for four additional Masks by the Act's completion.

Four more Mask Shards are accessible in [[Act 3]], allowing for a total of five additional Masks.
